title: Republic’s environmental services segment grows after pivot

sources.title: Republic’s environmental services segment grows after pivot
sources.excerpt: After a strategic adjustment on pricing and two straight quarters of year-over-year revenue declines, the segment logged 21% year-over-year growth in Q3.

title: Reworld CEO Mohammed departs after 5 years

sources.title: Reworld CEO Mohammed departs after 5 years
sources.excerpt: Azeez Mohammed began his tenure following EQT Infrastructure’s acquisition of the company in 2021. The change is effective immediately.

title: GFL sets Nov. 9 deadline for take-private offers, touts strong quarter

sources.title: GFL sets Nov. 9 deadline for take-private offers, touts strong quarter
sources.excerpt: The publicly traded company has retained a special committee of independent directors and outside advisors to examine any potential deal. Meanwhile, it reported a strong quarter on Thursday.

title: California AG Bonta sues Waste Connections over closed Chiquita landfill

sources.title: California AG Bonta sues Waste Connections over closed Chiquita landfill
sources.excerpt: State officials allege the company failed to properly manage hazardous material and leachate. In other news, a GFL expansion stalled in Wisconsin and a Casella-operated site in Maine got a favorable court ruling.

title: WM president says ‘we’ve turned a corner’ on healthcare waste profits

sources.title: WM president says ‘we’ve turned a corner’ on healthcare waste profits
sources.excerpt: During its Q3 earnings call, executives said the Healthcare Solutions sector hit key core price and expense targets while increasing operating EBITDA by 33%. Meanwhile, solid waste volumes are down.

title: Clean Harbors reveals $55M Los Angeles hub, co-CEO’s retirement
summary: The company recorded record revenue up 21% year over year in its third quarter earnings release. It also disclosed future plans, including transitioning Eric Gerstenberg to become sole CEO.
